profile.headline: Software Engineer @ HubSpot | Ex-Intuit | Mountain Biker | Snowboarder
profile.summary:
As a Staff Software Engineer, I oversee the entire software development lifecycle. My empathetic nature helps me translate requirements into enriched user experiences that exceed customer expectations. I have extensive experience developing both RESTful and RPC APIs, with a strong focus on performance and resilience. My passion lies in working on event-driven, distributed web applications and tackling the associated challenges. Additionally, I possess advanced knowledge and experience in deploying and optimizing AWS cloud infrastructure.

I earned the Engineering Excellence Award for modernizing two mission-critical services in TurboTax. I have led cloud migration projects that reduced costs and built CI/CD pipelines to enhance efficiency.

I am passionate about mentoring, continuous learning, and fostering cross-functional team collaboration without ego.

Skills:
Languages:  Java 17+, C#, JavaScript, Bash, SQL
Frameworks: Spring Boot 3, Google Guice, JPA
Databases:  MySQL, MSSQL, Cassandra, Redis
DevOps:     Docker, Jenkins, CircleCI, Maven
Cloud Services: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure

Key Concepts:
Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD)
Enterprise-level architectural patterns
Java design patterns
Distributed systems
Docker containerization
Platform as a Service (PaaS)
Software as a Service (SaaS)
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Configuration as Code (CaC)

I am always looking to expand my network. Feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn or email me at williams.yinka@gmail.com.
